description: This file defines the Fixer controller class for the OpenCart admin extension. It manages currency data integration with the Fixer.io API, providing functionalities to display configuration, save settings, and fetch/update currency rates from the API.

classes.name: Fixer
classes.description: Controller class for managing currency exchange rate updates via Fixer.io API in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the currency fixer configuration page with breadcrumbs and settings.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of currency fixer API settings after user permissions and input validation.

methods.name: currency
methods.description: Fetches latest currency rates from Fixer.io API and updates the local currency values in the database.
